# Requirements Quality Checklist: DEV-388 delete and host retirement

**Purpose**: Reviewer questions about whether the specification states the delete contract and the retirement boundary completely, clearly, and consistently
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-clarify` follow-on `/speckit-checklist`. Depth is standard. Audience is a reviewer before Gate 1. Focus is the delete contract and the retirement file boundary. Items test the requirements text, not an implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are both removal and absence outcomes specified, including status and body? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Do invalid ids follow the existing GET movie route: id less than or equal to zero is 404, a non-integer id is 400, with no id-specific 422, no empty validator, and no new authentication? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are movie-row, watchlist, metadata, join-set, shared-principal, other-movie, and on-disk file outcomes all specified for one delete? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the generated contract chain specified, including the snapshot and a ban on hand-edited types? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Are confirm, cancel, pending, success navigation, details-cache invalidation on the details view's own cache, 404-as-gone (invalidate and navigate, with no error or retry), and other-failure-with-retry all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the legacy test deletion list complete, including the named `EnrichmentTests` methods, exclusively supporting declarations, the kept assembly fixture, and removal of only the Web and Worker project references? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the README edits bound to the recon sentences at lines 10, 23, and 26, with drift stopping for recon, and are constitution, solution, Docker, CI, and `harness.yml` boundaries each specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "atomic" defined as one operation that reports removed versus absent, rather than an unruled storage API? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK009 Is list-plus-filters defined as the existing P1 filter set, with director and collection excluded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Is confirmation copy identified as assumed taste, with the words recorded in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the Q3 external product-plan citation marked as Patron-cited and not verified in recon roots? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Does Worker retirement stay allowed before Web, while Web waits on delete and the P1 parity map? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, User Story 2, User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the no-schema requirement agree with the edge case that refuses a collection table? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Does the ban on a new port agree with extending `IMovieRepository` rather than adding a repository layer? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK015 Are DEV-370 and DEV-385 closures excluded from this change in both requirements and out of scope? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can SC-001 through SC-003 be judged from observable responses and screens without a new performance target? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK017 Does SC-005 name the forbidden references and the absent host trees as pass conditions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Does SC-007 keep skip, opt-out, not-applicable, and could-not-run distinct from pass? [Clarity, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are primary, cancel, pending, non-404 failure, and DELETE 404 flows all present as acceptance scenarios? [Coverage, User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK020 Is repeat deletion specified as absence rather than a second success? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Is playback gating required to stay unchanged when Web is removed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are shared principals, another movie, and the on-disk file covered as survival cases? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Is an overlapping second delete required to report absence? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the legacy silent success explicitly rejected? [Edge Case Coverage, Spec §FR-003]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Is replacement evidence named before each host tree may be deleted, including the Api-hosted EnrichmentConsumer, its wiring, and the named integration proofs before Worker retirement? [Dependency, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the intake baseline distinguished from delivery verification? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK027 Is a missing recon fact required to stop as needs recon rather than a new design? [Dependency, tasks.md Notes]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK028 Does any requirement still ask for director or collection parity after Q3? [Conflict, Spec §FR-011, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [ ] CHK029 Does the spec leave a `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` marker or an unruled status code? [Ambiguity, Spec §Requirements]
- [ ] CHK030 Is out-of-scope follow-up limited to Critical, High, or broken behavior, with Low recorded as noted-no-ticket? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope]
